joint_bootstrap.note: Joint trajectory bootstrap recomputes all operating-side channels from the same resampled batch (within-batch covariance preserved) and the execution channel from the independent stream (stratified by sequence). The percentile interval is a genuine joint composite sampling interval; it addresses the share-conditional design limitation but not directed-information plug-in bias.

interpretation: Finite-sample implementation agreement on one registered instance from one joint log batch; not statistical consistency, not a power claim, and not external construct validation. Exact-truth composites are model anchors. The data-driven detection rule cannot confirm the near-zero NRI share at this sample size (INDETERMINATE is the honest outcome). Above-limit composite intervals are share-conditional (other channels fixed at points); their under-coverage reflects both plug-in bias and the conditional design. The joint bootstrap is a supplementary diagnostic, not the reported semantics, and does not remove plug-in bias.

sensitivity_thresholds.note: Post hoc frozen internal engineering thresholds on the composite scale, frozen after the R17-native results were observed; not a domain SESOI, not a power calculation. Evaluated against minimum-possible/worst-case convention separation (three-state system), never midpoint agreement.

replay_policy.justification: Capacity-achieving input distributions are generally non-unique; canonicalized coordinates carry a declared 1e-6 field tolerance, capacity-derived values 1e-9. Raw log hashes, counts, seeds, and statuses remain byte-exact and are never covered by float tolerances.

detection_rule_declaration.decision_interval: basic (pivotal) bootstrap interval of the bias-corrected share, clipped to [0,1]
detection_rule_declaration.reporting: BELOW/INDETERMINATE -> conservative LOGICAL_ENVELOPE [0, composite(upper)] (not a confidence interval); ABOVE -> SHARE-CONDITIONAL propagation of the share sampling interval (other channels fixed at points); plug-in composite retained only as diagnostic output

conditioning_note: Above-detection-limit composite sampling intervals are SHARE-CONDITIONAL: they propagate only the source-share basic bootstrap interval, with the execution, epistemic, and reflection channels fixed at their declared plugin/structural point estimates (conditioning_scope). They are NOT full joint-uncertainty intervals. Their under-coverage has two causes: (i) finite-sample plug-in bias of the directed-information share estimates, and (ii) the share-conditional design itself (other channels' estimation error and inter-channel covariance are not propagated). The supplementary joint trajectory bootstrap recomputes all channels per resample and quantifies the second cause; it does not remove the first. Logical-envelope anchor containment is a containment diagnostic, not statistical coverage, and is never combined with or compared against sampling-interval coverage.
bias_note: Plug-in directed-information estimates have finite-sample bias; the geometric composite amplifies near-zero share differences (x^0.2). The diagnostic plug-in NRI composite is NOT the reported certificate semantics: the formal certificate reports the data-driven detection status and the declared share-conditional interval / logical envelope. Exact-truth composites are model anchors, not evidence of finite-sample recoverability. On this instance the data-driven rule returns INDETERMINATE_NEAR_ZERO for NRI: the honest conclusion is that n=8192 data cannot confirm the near-zero share, not that the share is confirmed above it.
